method.disk_budget: Cooperative measured checkpoint after every 64 imports and at phase boundaries; not a filesystem quota.
method.memory: Whole-process high-water RSS via the unchanged semantic-cache measurement kernel.

method.public_operations: Separate measured public imports, exact retries, refused immutable replacement and checkpoint cancellation/retained-source resume after baseline reads.
method.restart: Build, traversal and restart run in distinct owned interpreter processes.
method.scope: One selected workspace plus a deliberately excluded workspace containing the same query.
method.search: Lexical terms; exact full result/source continuation; ranking remains local to each source window.
method.source_checks: All retained source hashes and catalog identities before/after measurements; quote actions sampled per result page.
method.timeout: Cooperative phase deadline plus a direct-interpreter outer timeout; remaining phases stop on failure.

full_traversal.reason: Full traversal belongs to the previous measured process.

value.profile_scope: Four exact 5b2 reports:1000x20,10000x20 and50000x20 all phases PASS;50000x40 build PASS and measure PARTIAL, later phases NOT_RUN; no other-head transfer

limits: Inspector only reads exact retained archives; no source execution or measurement is repeated.

All numbers are attributed to exact5b2 and each recorded runner environment.1000x20 and50000x40 report AWS;10000x20 and50000x20 report Azure. No cross-environment or cross-head speed ratio is asserted.

Three smaller profiles completed all5 requested phases. The50000x40 build passed, but measure exhausted the unchanged3600-second budget during full-result-traversal at1626500/2000000 verified results,48795 requests/copy samples and16265 complete source windows. Full2M capacity remains unmet.

The failed measure retains9 completed initial latency samples in progress only. Completed traversal percentile rows are absent and are not invented. Restart/operations/backup for this case were not run.
Passing traversal counts and P50/P95 are actual empirical rows; no new acceptance latency threshold or extrapolated completion time is asserted.
Fresh-interpreter restart is not a repeat of the full traversal and is not cold-disk evidence.
Retained fixture construction/public samples are not sustained whole-corpus public-import throughput. Native GUI, acoustics, physical audio, NVDA and release capacity remain outside this measurement.
